name: Pulmonary Lymphangioleiomyomatosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: European Respiratory Society (ERS) LAM Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Characteristic thin-walled cystic changes on high-resolution CT scan of the lungs
Presence of angiomyolipomas or chylous effusions
Diagnosis of tuberous sclerosis complex or presence of TSC gene mutations
Elevated serum vascular endothelial growth factor-D (VEGF-D) levels

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic lung cysts on HRCT plus either histological confirmation or presence of extrapulmonary manifestations (e.g., angiomyolipomas) or elevated VEGF-D
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Definitive diagnosis may require lung biopsy if clinical and radiologic criteria are inconclusive.

common.symptomName: Abdominal pain related to renal angiomyolipomas

occasional.symptomName: Leg swelling due to lymphatic obstruction

rare.symptomName: Neurological symptoms related to tuberous sclerosis complex

laboratory: Mild hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
imaging: High-resolution CT showing diffuse thin-walled lung cysts
Abdominal ultrasound or CT showing renal angiomyolipomas
Chest X-ray may show pneumothorax or pleural effusions
genetic: Mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 genes in some cases
other: Histopathology showing proliferation of abnormal smooth muscle-like LAM cells

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of cystic lung lesions typical of LAM
No association with angiomyolipomas or elevated VEGF-D
Nodular and cystic lung lesions predominantly in upper lobes
Presence of Langerhans cells on biopsy
Multisystem involvement with skin lesions, seizures
LAM may be a manifestation but TSC has broader clinical features

references: McCormack FX. Lymphangioleiomyomatosis: a clinical update. Chest. 2008;133(2):507-516.
European Respiratory Society guidelines for the diagnosis and management of lymphangioleiomyomatosis. Eur Respir J. 2010;35(1):14-26.
Young LR, et al. Serum VEGF-D as a diagnostic biomarker for lymphangioleiomyomatosis. N Engl J Med. 2010;362(18):1751-1758.
